loan_operation_modality_valid.name: loan_operation_modality_valid
loan_operation_modality_valid.value:
("loan_operation"."modality" = 'SINGLE' and "loan_operation"."installment_count" is null and "loan_operation"."installment_cents" is null and "loan_operation"."first_due_date" is null)
    or ("loan_operation"."modality" = 'INSTALLMENT' and "loan_operation"."installment_count" >= 1 and "loan_operation"."installment_cents" > 0 and "loan_operation"."first_due_date" is not null
      and "loan_operation"."total_cents" = "loan_operation"."installment_count" * "loan_operation"."installment_cents")
